summary: Inspected the assigned cart-lines source record and reference/rendered/diff crops. Wrapper geometry passes tolerance at actual (240,363,953x242) versus expected (240,364,953x240), but the crop differs by 10.194%, above the 8.5% threshold. The exact product and remove assets are present, while their child layout is displaced.
issues: CART-LINES-01 (high, child layout): expected product image at x=262 and remove icon at x=1131; actual retained metrics place them at x=287 and x=1111. The title, quantity and price are also visibly redistributed. Restore the source horizontal positions for image, title, quantity, price and remove control within the existing 953 px wrapper.

CART-LINES-02 (medium, vertical geometry): expected wrapper y=364, height=240; actual y=363, height=242. Although inside the geometry gate tolerance, the crop shows shifted border/content pixels contributing to the above-threshold mismatch.
